race.comment: COPY CAT QUEEN (2) was a big improver last week, coming form wider to score by more than a metre at this circuit and distance. Races well when third-up so may have progressed further and she is well served by the low draw. Hard to knock the consistency of DELIGHTFUL PEG NZ (5) who added to a string of top-two results when she came from the back row for second to COPY CAT QUEEN last week. Won from this barrier earlier in the campaign. Big chance to turn the tables. BEETASTIC NZ (10) won two in a row here before chasing the top two picks when placed last week. Draws for a trail and could be dangerous if she gets the gaps. FAKENIT (7) was far from disgraced after working last week. Respect.
